# n8n_credentials (Data Source)

Lists n8n credentials visible to the API key.

Results are paged internally using cursor pagination until the list is exhausted. Optional `name` and `type` filters are applied after listing (exact match). List is limited to instance owners and admins (`credential:list`); other keys receive HTTP 403.

List items include project `shared` rows. Secret `data` is never included. Live list items do not include `is_managed` or related flags; use `n8n_credential` for those.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_credentials" "all" {
}

data "n8n_credentials" "headers" {
  type = "httpHeaderAuth"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) When set, only credentials with this exact name are returned.
- `type` (String) When set, only credentials with this exact type are returned.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Credentials returned after following cursor pagination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier. Always `credentials`.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `id` (String) Credential ID.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `shared` (Attributes List) Projects this credential is shared with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--shared))
- `type` (String) n8n credential type name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials--shared"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials.shared`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the credential was shared with this project.
- `id` (String) Project ID this credential is shared with.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `role` (String) Sharing role (for example `credential:owner`).
- `updated_at` (String) When the sharing was last updated.
